steps.instruction: Welcome to the Acids and Bases experiment! Look at the two beakers. The red beaker contains an acid. The blue beaker contains a base.
First, we will pour the acid into the flask. Tell me: which liquid is the acid? Say red or acid.
Correct! Pouring the red acid into the flask now.
Now pour the blue base into the flask. Say pour blue or base.
Watch carefully! The acid and base are reacting. This is called neutralization. The mixture turns purple!
Outstanding! You completed the Acids and Bases experiment. When an acid and a base mix, they neutralize each other!
